messages:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — focus for today: LangChain / LlamaIndex adapter compatibility, gateway adapter routing, cloud marketplace packaging, HW perf validation, SI pilot scope, and announcement timeline. 30m? :calendar:
Miguel Torres: I'm in. FYI LangChain changed some chain args in the latest release — adapter needs a small API tweak. I've got a prototype branch.
Priya Patel: Can we confirm marketplace requirements? AWS/GCP both want packaging + security checklist + quickstart. Who owns the artifacts?
Dan Roberts: I can own AWS listing artifact. Need security certs + SSO integration details from eng.
Miguel Torres: Technical blockers to call out: 1) gateway passthrough auth (token exchange), 2) kv-cache shape differs for current LlamaIndex connector. Will push a patch and sample snippet.
Miguel Torres: ```
# adapter config example
adapter:
  route_policy: [latency, cost]
  default: hosted
  token_exchange: true
```
Helga (deploy-bot): CI: connector-llamaindex-ctx-fix (#482) — build passed :white_check_mark:
Alice Chen: For HW partners (NVIDIA/Graphcore), we need perf numbers on T4 vs A100 and quantization profiles (int8/4-bit). @Miguel can you run 2x latency+throughput profiles by EOD Wed?
Miguel Torres: Yep — will run a 1k request sample on A100 and T4, include mixed-precision runs, and upload CSV to the shared folder.
Priya Patel: For the announcement, proposing a soft launch with partners + joint blog + docs in same week. Tentative date: Apr 28. Thoughts?
Dan Roberts: :eyes: calendar looks okay. Need partner PR contacts and embargo window. Also SOW for SI pilot.
Alice Chen: Legal looped in — they need MOUs by Apr 15. I'll chase and pull partner contact list.
Priya Patel: Marketplace listing checklist: 1) architecture diagram, 2) quickstart, 3) pricing matrix, 4) security FAQ. I'll draft a starter in the repo at /marketplace/listings/llamaindex-redwood.md
Miguel Torres: Small engineering note: gateway adapter should include a feature flag to route between dedicated and hosted variants — I'll add config and tests.
Miguel Torres: Also adding a fallback policy when a model variant isn't available (route to compatible quantized variant).
Dan Roberts: SI pilot ask: 3-month POC, 2 prioritized use-cases, success metrics = p95 latency < 200ms and cost < $0.002/token. I'll draft SOW and share with partners.
Alice Chen: Actions: Miguel runs perf + open PR for adapter by Wed EOD; Dan drafts SOW + collects partner contacts; Priya kicks off marketplace draft + diagram; Legal to confirm MOU timeline by Apr 15. Sync next Tue 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Miguel Torres: :thumbsup:
Helga (deploy-bot): Reminder: pending review on branch connector-llamaindex-ctx-fix from @Miguel and @Priya.
